projects.title: Smart Mobility Wheelchair using AI Vision
projects.description: An AI-powered wheelchair built for elderly and disabled individuals to detect obstacles in real-time and provide voice alerts.
projects.longDescription: I built an assistive wheelchair prototype designed to help elderly and disabled users move safely. Using an ESP32-CAM and a Raspberry Pi running YOLOv8 object detection, the system identifies obstacles in the wheelchair's path and triggers instant voice alerts through Text-to-Speech.

projects.title: AI Smart Glass Navigation Assistant
projects.description: Wearable smart glasses for visually impaired users with obstacle detection, text reading (OCR), and voice guidance.
projects.longDescription: A wearable smart glass device powered by Raspberry Pi and ESP32-CAM. It assists visually impaired users by detecting obstacles via YOLOv8, reading signs or book text out loud using Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and giving voice navigation cues.

projects.title: AI Detects – Deepfake & Synthetic Media Detector
projects.description: A machine learning system that detects whether an image is real or AI-generated.
projects.longDescription: I developed a deep learning classifier in TensorFlow to detect AI-generated images and deepfakes. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) analyzes subtle pixel patterns to distinguish between real camera photographs and synthetic AI media.

projects.title: Career Compass
projects.description: An intelligent career guidance web platform that recommends career paths based on student skill assessment.
projects.longDescription: Career Compass is a web application that helps students discover matching career fields. It analyzes quiz responses and skill inputs using machine learning logic to generate personalized career recommendations.
